title: AnimationTree, blendspace editor expect a wide Godot win width
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e], v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935] ### System information Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description The selected point in the AnimationTree's blendspace editor, and the inspector panel, can become hidden past Godot's right window edge, because the blendspace editor's width is based on the number of controls shown on its toolbar. The following controls are added to the toolbar: When a point is selected: In 4.7.beta1, it adds: Index label, index spin box, position label, x spin box, and a y spin box In 4.6.2.stable, it adds: point label, x spin box, and a y spin box If the selected point is either of these: BlendSpace1D, BlendSpace2D, BlendTree, or StateMachine It adds a button: Open Editor In 4.7.beta1, when the Sync dropdown list is set to: Cyclic Constant It adds a cycle length spin box. In 4.6.2.stable the sync setting only has a checkbox, toggling it doesn't change the toolbar width. Disabling this button (triangle icon): Generate blendspace triangles automatically Adds a button: Create triangles by connecting points Now, to be able to see all those controls and the inspector, Godot's window width has to be: - in 4.7.beta1: 1920 - in 4.6.2.stable: 1535 This video shows what happens in 4.7.beta1: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/772fc6ea-6f0b-4e4b-b356-c50c6e447c75 Expected: Show all of the blendspace editor's controls and the inspector, when Godot has a narrow width. For example, when Godot's window is on one half of a 1920x1080 resolution monitor, while looking at references on the other half. Possible fixes: Maybe some of the controls could be shown in the inspector. Or there could be a left side panel in the blendspace editor, like the one in the tilemap panel. Or a toolbar button could open a popup, like the 3d workspace toolbar's three vertical dots button: Edit sun and environment settings Or the toolbar controls should wrap to a second line, like the viewport toolbar does, for example when an animation player node is selected. ##### Wrapped ### Steps to reproduce - open the project: [selected-blendshape-point-expects-wide-godot-win-width.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27270833/selected-blendshape-point-expects-wide-godot-win-width.zip) - resize Godot's window to it's minimum width - in the scene panel, click on the node: AnimationTree in 4.7.beta1, it opens the AnimationTree panel in 4.6.2.stable, it opens the bottom Animation panel, click on the bottom AnimationTree button - in the animationtree panel, click on the pencil icon on blendspace2d Issue: in 4.7.beta1, most of the inspector is hidden outside Godot's right window edge in 4.6.2.stable, half of the inspector is hidden - resize Godot's window width until the inspector is visible - at the right side of the blendspace editor, click on the top point at x1.0 y0.4 note: in 4.7.beta1, the point shows the name: new_animation The blendspace editor's width increased because the toolbar added these controls: In 4.7.beta1, it adds: Index label, index spin box, position label, x spin box, and a y spin box In 4.6.2.stable, it adds: point label, x spin box, and a y spin box Issue: Now all of these are hidden past Godot's right window edge: - the right side of the blendspace editor, including the selected point - the inspector - Godot's top right (run) buttons and the bottom right buttons (expand bottom panel, pin bottom panel) Continue steps: - resize Godot's width to show the inspector - click on the bottom right point at x1.0 y-0.6 note: in 4.7.beta1 the point shows the name: Blendspace1D The blendspace editor's toolbar added a button: Open Editor Issue: Half of the inspector is outside Godot's right window edge. - resize Godot's width to show the inspector - in 4.7.beta1, the blendspace toolbar has a sync dropdown list, choose: Cyclic Constant A cyclic length spin box was added to the right of the sync dropdown list. Note: in 4.6.2.stable, the sync setting is a checkbox, toggling it doesn't change toolbar width. Issue: The right side of the inspector is cut off. - resize Godot to show the inspector - near the left side of the blendspace toolbar, click on the button with a triangle icon to disable: Generate blendspace triangles automatically a new button appears on the toolbar: Create triangles by connecting points Issue: The right side of the inspector is hidden. - resize Godot to show the inspector Result: To be able to see the inspector when the blendspace toolbar has the widest number of controls: - in 4.7.beta1, Godot's window width has to be 1920 - in 4.6.2.stable, Godot's window width has to be 1535 ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [selected-blendshape-point-expects-wide-godot-win-width.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27270833/selected-blendshape-point-expects-wide-godot-win-width.zip)
